title: String Hoppers
description: String Hoppers is a Sri Lanka dish made with rice flour, yellow onion, coconut milk, desiccated coconut. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Uses a coconut-and-yogurt accompaniment; typical Sri Lankan coconut sambol or gravy differs.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 15 minutes.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Put the prepared parcels in a steamer over gently boiling water, cover, and steam for about 13 minutes until the filling is completely cooked.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 12 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
